gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-old-persia: Luckiest Guy shouts cheerfully, its ink poured at one width with a lofty stance, while Noto Sans Old Persian lets its open counters breathe. One is built to be loud; the other, to be read.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdia: Luckiest Guy is loud and cheerful, every stem and arch poured at identical thickness. Noto Sans Old Sogdian follows with a x-height nearly touching cap height, so a modest text size should stay crisp.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic is chunky and approachable, with open-mouthed curves that stay clear. Luckiest Guy leads above it with cheerful, loud strokes drawn as if by a fixed pen, and the plain sans below keeps the page friendly.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-osage: Cheerful from the first glance, Luckiest Guy draws its bowls at stem thickness and gets loud about it. Noto Sans Osage fills the line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves that never close up.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Oversized lowercase and wide, easy s turns make Noto Sans Osmanya feel clean and sure of itself. Luckiest Guy brings cheerful volume with no hairlines and no swells, so the sans-serif below simply gets on with the reading.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Luckiest Guy is cheerful and loud, cut out like a fixed-width router bit with its eye on the right. Noto Sans Palmyrene is the sans-serif that handles the quiet work, with curves that stop short and compressed ascenders.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Flat, contrast-free letterforms give Luckiest Guy its loud, cheerful punch, and its e opens clearly to the right. Noto Sans PhagsPa sits below with see-through c openings, a sans that gently steps up to capitals.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Luckiest Guy is cheerful and loud, with hairlines that never appear. Noto Sans Phoenician brings modern, generous lowercase height and s curves open wide at both ends, which makes the pair feel lively yet easy to follow.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic is neutral and modern, with a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves. And Luckiest Guy, hairline-free and shadow-free, earns its keep when it is big and short.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Loud, cheerful, and poured at a single width: that is Luckiest Guy. Noto Sans Samaritan brings hefty lowercase with plenty of daylight inside its curves, and that generous openness is the pair's strongest quality.
